name: vintage-film-fashion-portrait
image_vibe: Glamorous high-fashion silhouette with dramatic shadows and cinematic vintage color
image_purpose: Create a polished fashion lookbook portrait with a timeless film-editorial finish.

prompt.project_info: A glamorous high-fashion studio portrait of an original adult woman wearing a shimmering gown.
prompt.main_subject: An original adult woman in a shimmering couture gown with an elegant fashion pose and composed editorial presence. Preserve a refined silhouette, realistic skin texture, and the gown's reflective fabric without adding unsupported identity details.
prompt.composition_elements: Portrait-oriented studio composition with the subject as the sole focal point, clean fashion framing, visible gown texture and silhouette, and a restrained background that supports the dramatic lighting.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Dramatic directional studio lighting with deep controlled shadows, cinematic color grading, sculpted highlights on the shimmering gown, and a glamorous vintage-film atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Vintage film camera aesthetic, high-detail editorial fashion photography, realistic fabric and skin texture, subtle film grain, natural optical falloff, high-resolution clarity, no text or watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a glamorous high-fashion studio portrait of an original adult woman wearing a shimmering couture gown. Use dramatic directional lighting, deep controlled shadows, cinematic color grading, sculpted highlights on the gown, a clean portrait-oriented studio composition, realistic skin and reflective fabric texture, a vintage film camera aesthetic, subtle film grain, natural optical falloff, ultra-detailed editorial realism, and no text or watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, minor or teen-coded subject, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, distorted anatomy, extra fingers, deformed gown, watermark, text

assets.name: source vintage film fashion portrait
assets.usage: Use only as optional guidance for shimmering gown styling, dramatic shadows, cinematic grade, and vintage film treatment; do not copy identity.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Preserve the glamorous adult fashion portrait, shimmering gown, dramatic lighting, deep shadows, cinematic color grade, and vintage-camera atmosphere. Identity and non-essential studio details may vary.
